events.context: The workspace is empty, so the build is a from-scratch Vite + React scaffold. The starter-kit catalog doesn't include a React/Vite shell (only game_loop_vanilla, pwa_shell, ui_kit_dense, device_frames, app_shell), so the simplest reliable approach is a hand-rolled minimal Vite + React project — three source files plus the Vite config, no router, no extra UI deps. The heading is rendered as a single <h1> in App.jsx for trivial verification. The dev server is started through preview_start (platform-managed port), and browser verification is done with the browser tool rather than an http_ok done_condition — loopback preview URLs are explicitly disallowed as finish gates, so the browser screenshot is the runtime proof captured during execution, while file existence on the source files gates finish.
